title: 误改后的干净恢复点：拒绝最新自证清单，保留合法后续增量
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 给出题设要求的具体交付物与关键机制
用可观察结果验证约束和失败分支
明确停止条件及回退或恢复边界
body:
## 操作任务
实现recover(candidates,approved,live,approved_delta,target)。candidates为唯一id/time/path/manifest的有限恢复点目录列表，time越大越新；候选自带manifest不构成干净批准。approved为外部已确认干净点id→{文件名:SHA256}，选择其中最新且所有批准文件内容仍匹配的点，跳过已变更批准点；没有可用点ValueError且不得创建target。仅允许显式顶层[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*.json普通非符号链接文件。approved_delta是外部批准保留的live文件名→SHA256，须先验证匹配，否则拒绝。全新target/baseline只复制选定批准文件；target/pending-delta另存全部批准后续变更，不得自动并入干净基线。返回selected、conflicts（与基线同名但摘要不同）、added（基线中没有）排序列表。保留live/全部候选和输入对象，已有target拒绝覆盖。验收含最新自证但未批准点、较新批准后被篡改点、两个干净历史点、合法冲突修改和新增订单，独立业务读校验与候选只读权限；不执行候选脚本。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
自有真实目录、只读证据文件、实际复制与跨文件业务引用校验；干净批准由题设外部清单提供，不声称摘要能自动证明无污染。恢复产物为隔离副本和待审增量，未切生产入口、执行可疑内容或自动解决合并冲突，不证明真实存储故障、反恶意软件判断或任意元数据迁移。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,secrets,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='/workspace') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);live=root/'live';live.mkdir();candidates=[];approved={}
 value=secrets.token_hex(12)
 for generation in (1,2,3,4):
  path=root/('point-'+str(generation));path.mkdir()
  items=json.dumps({'generation':generation,'value':value if generation<=2 else 'untrusted-rewrite'},sort_keys=True).encode()
  index=json.dumps({'generation':generation,'items_sha256':sha(items)},sort_keys=True).encode()
  (path/'items.json').write_bytes(items);(path/'index.json').write_bytes(index)
  # A script is inert evidence, never a restore deliverable or something to execute.
  (path/'startup.sh').write_text('untrusted evidence only')
  manifest={'items.json':sha(items),'index.json':sha(index)}
  candidates.append({'id':'point-'+str(generation),'time':generation,'path':str(path),'manifest':manifest})
  if generation in (1,2,4):approved['point-'+str(generation)]=copy.deepcopy(manifest)
  if generation==4:(path/'items.json').write_bytes(b'altered-after-approved-manifest')
  for file in path.iterdir():os.chmod(file,0o444)
  os.chmod(path,0o555)
 baseline_items=(root/'point-2/items.json').read_bytes()
 (live/'items.json').write_text(json.dumps({'generation':9,'value':'legitimate-approved-later-edit'}))
 (live/'orders.json').write_text(json.dumps({'new_order':secrets.token_hex(8)}))
 (live/'unapproved.json').write_text('do not merge this')
 delta={name:sha((live/name).read_bytes()) for name in ('items.json','orders.json')}
 before={str(file.relative_to(root)):sha(file.read_bytes()) for file in root.rglob('*') if file.is_file()}
 inputs=copy.deepcopy([candidates,approved,delta]);target=root/'recovery'
 try:
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:approved_clean_point_not_latest_self_manifest_and_retain_post_point_delta',flush=True)
  result=task.recover(candidates,approved,live,delta,target)
  assert result=={'selected':'point-2','conflicts':['items.json'],'added':['orders.json']},'newest intact explicitly approved clean point was not chosen'
  assert [candidates,approved,delta]==inputs
  restored=target/'baseline';pending=target/'pending-delta'
  assert set(p.name for p in restored.iterdir())=={'items.json','index.json'}
  assert set(p.name for p in pending.iterdir())==set(delta),'legitimate post-point changes lost'
  for name,digest in delta.items():assert sha((pending/name).read_bytes())==digest
  assert (restored/'items.json').read_bytes()==baseline_items
  actual=json.loads((restored/'items.json').read_bytes());index=json.loads((restored/'index.json').read_bytes())
  assert actual['generation']==index['generation']==2 and actual['value']==value and index['items_sha256']==sha(baseline_items)
  assert (restored/'items.json').read_bytes()!=(pending/'items.json').read_bytes(),'conflicting delta silently merged into clean baseline'
  assert not any(p.name=='startup.sh' for p in target.rglob('*'))
  after={str(file.relative_to(root)):sha(file.read_bytes()) for file in root.rglob('*') if file.is_file() and not file.is_relative_to(target)}
  assert before==after,'live data or recovery evidence changed'
  for bad_approved,bad_delta in ({},delta),(approved,{'orders.json':'0'*64}):
   refused=root/('refused-'+secrets.token_hex(3))
   try:task.recover(candidates,bad_approved,live,bad_delta,refused)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('missing clean approval or changed delta accepted')
   assert not refused.exists()
  try:task.recover(candidates,approved,live,delta,target)
  except FileExistsError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('existing recovery overwritten')
  print('NATIVE_READONLY_POINTS_CLEAN_BUSINESS_READ_AND_SEPARATE_CONFLICTING_DELTA',flush=True)
 finally:
  for candidate in candidates:os.chmod(candidate['path'],0o755)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
